assemblyNotes: Rigid reconstruction2026-11-02: MainBody original orientation validated by16.9/8/8mm side-hole spacing; CoreS3 rear plane meets z22.6532; source head envelope61.5mm incl2mm rear tab. Base Z+12.75/Y-1.6 from independent dimension drawing side landmarks; standZ+12.75, coverY-10 estimated pending hardware fit. No scale/deformation. limitations: Manufacturer STL meshes retain original dimensions. Assembly is reconstructed from source mating features and product photographs; no physical fit or motion-direction calibration performed.
Blank UNKNOWN PCB layers represent missing board layouts; estimated outlines, thicknesses and placement must not be mistaken for manufacturer PCB CAD.
Servo housings use the SCS0009 drawing dimensions; internal gears, wiring and mechanical contact/loads are not modeled.

SCS0009 end tabs use a rectangular envelope. A nominal0.55mm tilt-ear/fork overlap remains unresolved; precise ear rounding and actual installed clearance need manufacturer assembly data or physical measurement.
Battery capacity550mAh is official; pouch geometry and placement are enclosure-space estimates with no inferred manufacturer markings.
Photograph-informed colors and labels are uncalibrated display approximations. Product photos remain manufacturer copyright, not project MIT.

Runtime is implemented separately: guest servo feedback drives the articulated joints, twelve RGB values drive optical windows, and pad/screen inputs reach the board. See docs/platform/stackchan-runtime.md for tested functions and remaining limitations.
